caption:
Real honor is not about where you come from

Allah created us from a male and a female and made us nations and tribes so that we may recognize one another. The most noble before Him is the most righteous, and He is All-Knowing, All-Aware.

Surah Al-Hujuraat 49:13

Send this to a friend from a different background

#equalityinislam #unity #righteousness #quranreels

Recitation: Abdul Rahman Al-Sudais
alt_text: O mankind, We have created you from a male and a female, and made you into nations and tribes so that you may recognize one another. Indeed, the most noble of you before Allah is the most righteous among you. Indeed, Allah is All-Knowing, All-Aware (Surah Al-Hujuraat 49:13)
